<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **3** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via os meta register (command, read off packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register.ts))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **58** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e0050baaceaece398cba4bc207ba69f42643c762` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `982c8b1abf7a189e514e309025eff42b063db87d` — the merge of head `8cfc5d6fe478d8b8e9ffb8307b0115a8b16f8c58` into base `e0050baaceaece398cba4bc207ba69f42643c762`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 982c8b1abf7a189e514e309025eff42b063db87d && git checkout 982c8b1abf7a189e514e309025eff42b063db87d
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin e0050baaceaece398cba4bc207ba69f42643c762 8cfc5d6fe478d8b8e9ffb8307b0115a8b16f8c58 && git checkout -B drift-repro e0050baaceaece398cba4bc207ba69f42643c762 && git merge --no-ff 8cfc5d6fe478d8b8e9ffb8307b0115a8b16f8c58

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e0050baaceaece398cba4bc207ba69f42643c762
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs e0050baaceaece398cba4bc207ba69f42643c762` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8cfc5d6fe478d8b8e9ffb8307b0115a8b16f8c58`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-mcp-build/evals/draft-door-procedure.json + packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register-draft.test.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioChangesLink.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioInterfacesRetired.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioInterfacesRetired.test.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioInterfacesRetiredNotice.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx (the redirect, the latched notice and the `?changes=` reader only), ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.copilotDoors-12894.test.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.interfacesRetired-36502.test.tsx
Security-touching: no

Inputs read: card #36502 (body and all eight comments, rulings 7081151402, 7122806677, routing 7122821486, claim 7122916295, note 7125830872), PR #36884 (body, file list, net diff `origin/main...pr-36884`, 178 files, +1,538 / −35,609), and the check-runs on this head. The rest of the diff (the deleted Interfaces pillar and its 80 test files, the Customize door moved to All metadata, console link re-pointing, checklist JSON, README, i18n) is outside this record: it is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`, and the PR stays Tier H on size whatever this record says.

Check-runs on the head at the time of writing (66 runs): 25 success, 10 skipped, 31 in progress, 0 failed. Success: Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Build UI Deps, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, Lint · ESLint / docs & code guards / repo & tooling gates / CI, release & engine gates / the three scoped lint jobs. STILL IN PROGRESS, so no verdict yet: Build Core, Build & E2E UI, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Test Core 1–10 of 10, Test UI 1–16 of 16. The tests that pin the scope files (`mcp-authoring.test.ts`, `register-draft.test.ts`, `studioInterfacesRetired.test.ts`, `copilotDoors-12894`, `interfacesRetired-36502`) run in those unfinished shards; this record reads them, it does not stand in for their result.

### ① Derived judgments

- `save_metadata_draft` reply, `review.changes` (`mcp-authoring.ts#reviewRoutes`): the value moves from `/studio/PKG/interfaces?changes=review` to `/studio/PKG/data?changes=review`. Right. The key set (`changes`, `item`, `note`) and `review.item` are unchanged; only a route string inside a value moves, and the old value still resolves (below). Both tests that pin it are re-pointed in the same diff.
- `os meta register --mode draft` output (`register.ts#draftSaveLines`): the second line prints the same new route. Right; `register-draft.test.ts` pins it at the unit and at the real save door.
- Console route surface: `/studio/PKG/interfaces` stops being a pillar and becomes a redirect to `/studio/PKG/data`; `/studio/PKG` with no tab opens `data` (`STUDIO_HOME_PILLAR`). Right against card items 2 and 3. A removed route that keeps answering is not a narrowing of anything an author can write.
- Eval accept set: eval 3's `must_contain` moves from the old link to `/studio/com.acme.crm/data?changes=review`; eval 1 keeps the looser `changes=review`. Right: both follow the producer.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: three keys added (`engine.studio.interfacesRetired.sentence`, `.backToApp`, `.dismiss`, en and zh). Additive. The zh sentence is the card's own wording, 「界面的修改已经搬到应用里」.
- No published schema, spec key, export map or stored shape moves in the scope files. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so the deleted modules are not a published accept set.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/36502-retire-studio-interfaces.md` is `patch` on `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/cli`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, and the PR body carries the same two lines at line start. The level is right: no metadata key, accepted value or type changes, so `none` takes `patch` (AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3). `Clause-②: no` is right: no published accept set moves, and no arm is owed because the old route still answers. The body's account of the review link and of the redirect matches the code. One gap in the package list, N1 in ④. `Check Changeset` is green on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag, #36444 waived: answered by ruling 7122806677 on the card. The PR body states the consequence (public forms have no visual editor until #36444 lands). Read in the tree, not taken from the body: every symbol PR #36784 (head `1f9f2343`) imports from these folders is still exported on this head (`StudioBaseCustomization`, `StudioSavedDraft`, `STUDIO_SYSTEM_FIELD_NAMES`, `declaredOverrideOf`, `overrideDraftBody`, `markShippedOff`).
- Dev flag, two extra producers of the old route (claim 7122916295): answered in the diff; all three producers are re-pointed and no fourth exists (④).
- Note 7125830872, pointer 2 (redirects as one central from → to table; say what "Studio first screen" means): met in substance. One module (`studioInterfacesRetired.ts`) holds the one retired segment, the one target and the kept-parameter list as exported data, and the PR body names the first screen as the Data pillar (`STUDIO_HOME_PILLAR`). It is a single function, not a literal table; #36895 can take it over as it stands.
- ESCALATED to the lane seat and the maintainer's Tier H read, E1: the card's acceptance line 「HotCRM 上：改菜单、改一个列表视图、改一个仪表盘、调一次记录页分组，全部在应用里完成，不需要进 Studio」 and ruling 7122806677 ("the HotCRM walk stays, as the dev's verification step") are not met by what the PR reports. The PR body says the walk checked that the in-app entries are present and did not re-drive the four writes. The same body, and `metadataArea.ts` in this diff, say that on a read-only package (HotCRM is installed, so read-only) a shipped view is not editable in the running app and is customized on its All-metadata item page in Studio. So for a shipped HotCRM list view, 「不需要进 Studio」 may be false on this head. Outside this record's scope files; it must be answered before ACCEPT, by driving the walk or by the maintainer's word.
- ESCALATED, E2: the card says an editing function missing from its table 「要先报」. Customize on a read-only base is such a row, and the diff widens `AREA_CUSTOMIZE_EDITOR_TYPES` to `view, dashboard, report, page` to keep it. The PR body cites a seat note (07:01Z) accepting this; no comment on the card records it. The route is the conservative one (it keeps an existing capability), but the acceptance needs to be on the card or in the lane seat's ACCEPT.
- No `open_questions` entry is carried on the card or in the PR body.
- SQL push-down: nothing to find. The two server-side changes are string literals; the scope's UI files issue no query. No new id materialisation and no in-app join.
- `Security-touching` reasoning (kept off its own line): the changed eval lines differ from `main` in one route segment, four times, plus one `must_contain` string. The surrounding sentences about a person publishing in Studio are unchanged bytes on the same JSON lines; no hunk changes what is taught about permission, sharing, credentials, tokens or authentication.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectstack-mcp-build/evals/draft-door-procedure.json`** — holds.
- Against the producer: the prompt replies in evals 1 and 3 quote `review.changes` as `/studio/com.acme.crm/data?changes=review`, which is exactly what `reviewRoutes('com.acme.crm', …)` returns on this head (`encodeURIComponent` leaves the id unchanged). `review.item` (`/studio/com.acme.crm/metadata/flow/crm_lead_created_notify?review=1` and the dataset twin) matches the unchanged template. The expected outputs give the same string, and eval 3's `must_contain` requires it byte for byte.
- Against the skill it evaluates: `SKILL.md` line 93 says to give the save reply's `review` routes as written. The eval now shows a reply a live server produces, so "as written" and the expected text agree. Before this change a model following the skill against a live server would have failed eval 3's old assertion; the eval had to move with the producer, and it did in the same diff.
- Against the scenario (card item 6): no other file under `skills/` names the old route or the Interfaces column. Evals 2 and 4 carry no route.
- Does the taught link land? Yes, read in the tree. `?changes=` is read in `StudioDesignSurfaceBody`, above every pillar, so the drawer opens on Data for any item type (eval 1's draft is a flow). `review.item` still opens the generic draft review: `areaItemOpensFormEditor` keeps its `?review=1` exception, so widening the customize-editor types does not capture it.

**`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts`, `packages/cli/src/commands/meta/register.ts`, `studioChangesLink.ts`** — agree with the contract and with each other. All three build `/studio/` + encoded package id + `/data?changes=review`; the jsdoc in each was moved with the code. A paired `PKG.custom` id resolves: the surface redirects a pair's pillar URL to its base and keeps the query.

**The redirect (`studioInterfacesRetired.ts`, its wiring in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `StudioInterfacesRetiredNotice.tsx`)** — agrees with card item 3.
- `/studio/PKG/interfaces` matches `/studio/:packageId/:tab`; the check runs before the pair redirect and before the body, so no state exists in which the retired segment reaches the not-found branch. `?surface=` and every other pillar parameter are dropped; `?changes=` is kept, all values. The old link every already-printed CLI line and MCP reply carries therefore still opens the drawer, pinned by `copilotDoors-12894` ("an old /interfaces?changes=review link lands on the Data pillar with the drawer open").
- Tried to break it: (a) the Data pillar's own `?surface=` write and the drawer's `?changes=` delete both replace the entry without state, which would erase a notice read from `location.state` — the notice is latched in component state keyed on the landing pillar, and a test pins that it outlasts the `?surface=` write; (b) a pair id on the old URL — resolved to the base in the redirect itself; (c) the package-less scope `~org` — lands on `/studio/~org/data`, which the body forwards to its one pillar, and the latch clears because the tab changed: no error, no notice, acceptable for a scope with no app to go back to; (d) an unknown `?changes=` value — dropped, nothing opens (CONTROL test); (e) a missing package — the existing not-found state, as before.
- "Back to the app" reuses `studioBackTarget` and the header's unsaved-work veto, so it cannot leave past a held edit.

**Other producers still printing the old link** — none. `git grep` on this head over `skills/`, `packages/`, `ui/`, `content/docs` (releases excluded) and `docs/`, tests and CHANGELOGs excluded, finds the old route only as the redirect's own documentation (`studioInterfacesRetired.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/README.md` line 641) and as retirement history in two checklist steps. No `changes=review` string exists outside the three producers and the eval.

Findings:

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 (nit, prose face) — the changeset names four packages but not `@objectstack/skills`, the published package whose bytes `skills/**` is (`packages/skills` copies the catalog byte for byte, evals included), nor `@object-ui/app-shell`, where nearly all of the diff lives. Repo practice names both (57 and 171 of the changesets now in `.changeset/` respectively; `d2fc055a17` changed a skill eval and reference and named skills). Versions are unaffected (skills is in the fixed group and moves with runtime and cli), so the only effect is that neither CHANGELOG carries the entry. Fix on the changeset: add `'@objectstack/skills': patch` and `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`.
- N2 (nit) — `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` lines 450 and 526 cite `studioInterfacesRetired.tsx`; the file is `studioInterfacesRetired.ts` (the notice is `StudioInterfacesRetiredNotice.tsx`).
- N3 (nit) — the notice's jsdoc says it is "shown again only by another old URL". Where the Data pillar writes no `?surface=` (a package with no object) and no `?changes=` was carried, the landing's history state survives, so a browser reload shows the notice again after Dismiss. Cosmetic.
- N4 (nit, outside the diff, follow-up card at most) — `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/door-rules-corpus.ts` line 90 still says "Studio's Interfaces pillar shows \"no app\"", and code comments in `AppHeader.tsx` (456), `DashboardView.tsx` (11) and `RuntimeDraftBar.tsx` (6) still describe authoring as living in the Interfaces pillar. None prints a link.

Verdict basis: the `hits` file and every implementing file agree with the card and with each other, and every printed review link, old or new, lands in a drawer that opens. PASS on this scope. It does not cover E1 and E2, which stay open for the lane seat's ACCEPT and the maintainer's Tier H approval, and it is rendered while 31 check-runs (all Test Core and Test UI shards among them) have not concluded.

**Mechanical.**

- `l1-face`: 12 of 13 items ok; all-checks 61 success · 12 expected skips · 0 failed · 0 pending; `mergeable_state` clean. One flag, `changeset`, answered under the second Read bullet.

**Read.**
- `Fixes #36502` is right. Item 2: the pillars are Data · Automations · Access · All metadata, and the Studio root opens `data` (`STUDIO_HOME_PILLAR`). Item 3: `/studio/<pkg>/interfaces`, with or without `?surface=`, redirects before the pair redirect and before the body, keeps only `?changes=`, and latches the notice in state. That state outlives the Data pillar's own `?surface=` write, which is pinned in `interfacesRetired-36502`. Item 6: `git grep` on this head finds no producer of `/interfaces` outside the redirect's own documentation and CHANGELOG history. The three `?changes=review` producers (`mcp-authoring.ts`, `register.ts`, `studioChangesLink.ts`) agree byte for byte with the eval.
- Changeset, sentence by sentence: every sentence holds against the tree. The `changeset` flag names `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`. Each is touched by one file under `src/__tests__/`. Both packages ship `files: ["dist", …]` and build with `tsconfig` excluding `**/__tests__/**`, so nothing they publish changes and no entry is owed. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`.
- Customize moved to All metadata (the seat's option A). `AREA_CUSTOMIZE_EDITOR_TYPES` gains `view, dashboard, report, page`. `ViewDefaultInspector`, `DashboardDefaultInspector`, `ReportDefaultInspector` and `PageDefaultInspector` are registered in `metadata-admin/inspectors/index.ts`, so `StudioBundleItemEditor` draws the designer and not the form. `?review=1` keeps the generic draft review. The routes are pinned in `StudioMetadataArea.routes-28561` and `metadataArea.test.ts`. The end-to-end customize, publish, serve and restore flow is pinned in `ui/e2e/live/studio-customize-journey.spec.ts`, and Live E2E UI is green on this head.
- Console links: `appStudioSurfacePath`, `artifactStudioPath` and `PageView` open `/studio/<pkg>/metadata/<type>/<name>`. `AiChatPage` and `AppHeader` open `/data`. No source under `ui/packages/*/src` names the `interfaces` segment except `RETIRED_INTERFACES_SEGMENT`.
- What PR #36784 imports is still exported (ruling 7122806677). This was read in the tree by the contract review and agrees with the PR's census.

**For the maintainer's approval (not findings against this head):**
- E1, acceptance line 「改一个列表视图…全部在应用里完成，不需要进 Studio」. On an installed, read-only package such as HotCRM, the running app's View settings saves a shipped view only as "my view" (objectstack#35974, which predates this PR). Org-wide customizing of a shipped view, dashboard, report or page into `<base>.custom` is still a Studio door: the All-metadata item page, replacing the Interfaces header. The 维护者速读 says so in its second bullet. The HotCRM walk checked that the in-app entries are present, and the writes were walked on the prerequisite cards. This PR changes none of those in-app write paths (`AppHeader.tsx` changes only a navigate target). Approving this PR accepts that reading of the acceptance line.
- E2: closed. The seat recorded option A, and the narrow reading of 「不需要进 Studio」, on card #36502 (7126312510).

**Nits (no effect on correctness):**
- N1. The changeset does not name `@objectstack/skills`, whose published bytes include `skills/**/evals`. It is in the fixed group with runtime and cli, so versions are unaffected, and only its CHANGELOG lacks the line (contract review N1).
- N2. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` lines 450 and 526 cite `studioInterfacesRetired.tsx`. The file is `.ts`.
- N3. The notice's jsdoc says it is "shown again only by another old URL". On a package with no object and no `?changes=`, a reload after Dismiss shows it again.
- N4. Stale "Interfaces pillar" prose outside the diff: `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/door-rules-corpus.ts:90` and comments in `AppHeader.tsx`, `DashboardView.tsx` and `RuntimeDraftBar.tsx`. This is a follow-up at most. #36893 / #36895 touch these surfaces next.

Every open finding is a nit, so ACCEPT. Under the human-merge rule, no seat readies, enqueues or auto-merges this PR. It lands after a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval.

## HotCRM walk: the four in-app writes, driven (answers L2 E1)

Setup: hotcrm main 48082b7 on its published 18.6.0 backend (:4011), served by this branch's console build (`vite preview`), signed in as the seeded admin, Playwright Chromium, en-US. App `crm_enterprise` of the installed (read-only) package `app.objectstack.hotcrm`. The network lines are the non-GET requests each step sent.

| Card step | In-app path | What was sent | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Change a menu | Sidebar app menu → Design layout → Actions for Home → Move down → Save | `POST /api/v1/packages/app.objectstack.hotcrm/ensure-customization` 201 · `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/crm_enterprise?mode=draft&package=app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom` 200 · `POST …/app/crm_enterprise/publish?package=app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom` 200 | Saved into the pair, no Studio |
| Change a dashboard | `executive_dashboard` → Edit this dashboard → Remove widget (Total Contacts) → Save | `ensure-customization` 200 · `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/executive_dashboard?mode=draft&package=app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom` 200 · `POST …/dashboard/executive_dashboard/publish?package=app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom` 200; toast "Dashboard saved" | Saved into the pair, no Studio |
| Change a list view | Accounts → View settings → hide Type → Save | The only offer is "Save as my view": `POST /api/v1/data/sys_personal_view` 201 | A personal view, no Studio. A shared change to the shipped `all_accounts` view is made on its All-metadata page. This is the limit the seat accepted on the card and the PR body's 维护者速读 states (in place since #35974, not changed here) |
| Arrange the record page | An account record → ⋯ → Configure tabs → hide Contacts → Save | `ensure-customization` 200 · `PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/crm_account?mode=draft&package=app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom` **422** `<root> [unrecognized_keys]`; body `{"extend":"crm_account","relatedLists":[…,{"list":"crm_contact","hidden":true}]}` | Refused by the server, version skew: `object_extension.relatedLists` is ADR-0146 D10 (#36818), newer than the 18.6.0 backend this HotCRM runs on. The console is main's, so it writes the key; a backend from the same main accepts it. Not this PR's code path (record tabs are #36499's; this diff does not touch `recordTabsConfigIo.tsx` or the spec) |

Two notes on the fourth row:
- The entry is in the app (⋯ → Configure tabs, with each tab marked Original package / From <package>), so the "no Studio" half holds. The write itself needs a backend of the same release as the console. HotCRM gets it when it moves past 18.6.0.
- The editor's "Adjust field groups" link opens `/studio/app.objectstack.hotcrm/data?surface=object:crm_account`: field groups live in Studio's Data pillar (the Field layout tab, #36505 / PR #36888), not in the retired Interfaces column.

No link on any page walked points at `/interfaces`. The head is unchanged (8cfc5d6f).
